description_en: Creates a diagnostic metric set for resources. You can flexibly combine diagnostic metrics as needed
description_zh: 调用CreateDiagnosticMetricSet创建资源诊断指标集合。您可以根据需要，灵活组合诊断指标
kebab_example: aliyun ecs create-diagnostic-metric-set --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type instance --metric-ids Instance.DiskLoadFailure --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDiagnosticMetricSet

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource to diagnose.

Default value: instance
parameters.help_zh:
诊断资源类型。

默认值：instance
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the diagnostic metric set
parameters.name: metric_set_name

parameters.help_en: The list of diagnostic metrics. A maximum of 100 metrics are supported
parameters.help_zh: 诊断指标列表。最多支持100个
parameters.name: metric_ids

parameters.help_en: The description of the diagnostic metric set
parameters.help_zh: 诊断指标集合的描述信息
parameters.name: description

MetricSetId.description_en: The unique ID of the diagnostic metric set
MetricSetId.description_zh: 诊断指标集合的唯一识别码
